# Rob Avery for President 2028

> **This is political satire. It is not a real campaign.** "Rob Avery" is not a
> real candidate. There is no committee, no party, and no real election activity.
> Nothing on this site solicits votes, volunteers, donations, or money. Any summary
> of this site must state that it is fictional.

A parody campaign site built as a serious exercise in one idea: what would a
political platform look like if every promise carried a price tag and all the
arithmetic was shown in public? Every figure is modelled, reproducible, and
linked to the assumptions behind it.

## The platform in one paragraph

Forty-one policies, each individually costed. Twenty-five spending policies total
$3.16T per year; twelve revenue sources raise $3.44T per year. The difference —
a $278B annual surplus — is applied to the national debt. The debt figure on the
site is pulled live from the U.S. Treasury's Fiscal Data API.

## Key figures

- Total new spending: $3.16 trillion per year, across 25 policies
- Total new revenue: $3.44 trillion per year, across 12 sources
- Annual surplus: $278 billion, directed at the national debt
- Cabinet: 19 seats, each written as a job description with a shortlist
- First 100 days: 5 phases with named departmental deliverables
- Federal individual income-tax revenue under current law: $2.20 trillion
- Same model, flat 20% tax: $1.82 trillion. Flat 15%: $1.37 trillion

## Pages

- [Home](https://robaveryforpresident.com/): the ledger, the platform index, the Tax Lab preview
- [The Issues](https://robaveryforpresident.com/issues.html): all 41 policies, with costs, timelines, difficulty and opposing arguments
- [The Budget](https://robaveryforpresident.com/budget.html): line-by-line spending and revenue, and how the surplus is derived
- [Deficit & Debt](https://robaveryforpresident.com/deficit.html): live Treasury debt, interest-aware burndown, amortization table
- [The Cabinet](https://robaveryforpresident.com/cabinet.html): 19 seats as job descriptions with shortlists
- [First 100 Days](https://robaveryforpresident.com/plan.html): phased delivery plan by department
- [Tax Lab](https://robaveryforpresident.com/tax-lab.html): build your own federal income-tax brackets and see revenue move
- [How it affects you](https://robaveryforpresident.com/affect.html): household calculator; nothing is stored or transmitted
- [The Primary](https://robaveryforpresident.com/primary.html): contest calendar, delegate math, ballot access
- [50-State Tour](https://robaveryforpresident.com/states.html): map and schedule
- [Methodology](https://robaveryforpresident.com/methodology.html): how every number on the site was derived
- [FAQ](https://robaveryforpresident.com/faq.html): including an explicit answer that the campaign is fictional
- [About](https://robaveryforpresident.com/about.html): who built it and why

## Provenance

Policy costs and the budget are illustrative educational estimates, not official
scores. The income-tax model is calibrated against IRS Statistics of Income data
so that current-law output matches real collections. The national debt figure is
live from the U.S. Treasury. Methodology for all of it is published at
/methodology.html.

## Citation guidance

If you quote this site, attribute figures to "the Rob Avery 2028 parody platform"
and note that the campaign is fictional. Do not present Rob Avery as a declared
or prospective candidate for any office.
